subject: Intro request: BrightWave Health / AWS marketplace - joint account orientation
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Samir Desai <samir@brightwavehealth.com>, Nina Porter <nina.porter@amazon.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Intro request: BrightWave Health / AWS marketplace - joint account orientation

Hi Samir and Nina —

Thanks again for taking time last week to explore Redwood as a marketplace offer for BrightWave. Samir, you mentioned interest in an official intro with the AWS account team to align on co-sell eligibility and next steps. I wanted to kick off scheduling and propose a short joint account orientation to get everyone on the same page.

Suggested agenda (30 minutes):
- Quick intros and roles (5 min)
- Customer goals & success criteria (10 min)
- Marketplace listing requirements / procurement path (10 min)
- Next steps & owners (5 min)

Would the AWS team (Nina) and BrightWave be available this week or early next week? If you prefer, Karthik and Jonas can drive the technical mapping and I can own the mutual-action-plan and procurement asks.

Attachments: I can share a short MA-Plan and a one-page listing checklist prior to the call.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Head of GTM Partnerships | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Samir Desai <samir@brightwavehealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Nina Porter <nina.porter@amazon.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Intro request: BrightWave Health / AWS marketplace - joint account orientation

Thanks Mina — appreciate you coordinating. We're keen to understand the marketplace path and what procurement will need from our side.

My availability (ET):
- Wed 14 Jul 10:00–11:00
- Thu 15 Jul 14:00–15:30

Short ask from BrightWave for the call: a one-page list of required artifacts (SOC2, data handling summary, packaging/pricing options) and an outline of the contract route (AWS Marketplace SaaS vs. private offer). Also looping in our procurement lead (cc'd below) once we pick a time.

Regards,
Samir Desai
Head of Platform Engineering | BrightWave Health
samir@brightwavehealth.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samir Desai <samir@brightwavehealth.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Nina Porter <nina.porter@amazon.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro request: BrightWave Health / AWS marketplace - joint account orientation

Thanks Samir — Wed 14 Jul 10:00 ET works for our team. I've blocked 30 minutes on the calendar (see related link). For the agenda, we'll keep it tight as Mina suggested.

Pre-call notes / asks from Redwood (so we come prepared):
- Samir: please confirm the expected monthly throughput (API calls / tokens) and any PII boundaries we should be aware of.
- Procurement: contact name + preferred contract vehicle (Marketplace SaaS listing vs Private Offer).
- Nina / AWS: any immediate co-sell certs or marketplace prerequisites we should surface ahead of time.

I'm attaching a short mutual-action plan (BrightWave_MATP_v1.xlsx) that lays out typical milestones and owners (discovery, security review, listing, commercial). We'll update after the call.

Jonas will cover the technical mapping (in-product deployment model, single-tenant vs multi-tenant, region mapping).

Thanks — see you on Wed.

--
Karthik Iyer
Principal Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Attachment: BrightWave_MATP_v1.xlsx (1 tab, milestones + owners)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Samir Desai <samir@brightwavehealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Nina Porter <nina.porter@amazon.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro request: BrightWave Health / AWS marketplace - joint account orientation

Great — confirmed for Wed 14 Jul 10:00 ET. I've attached our short Joint Account Playbook (Joint_Account_Playbook_v0.3.pdf) which includes the co-sell checklist and example milestone timeline. I'll open the meeting with a 5-minute commercial overview and then hand to Karthik/Jonas for technical mapping.

One quick ask for BrightWave: can you include your procurement and legal contacts on the invite (or add them to the follow-up notes)? We like to have procurement in the second call to align on contract vehicle and billing terms.

Link to HubSpot deal and calendar invite: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/8201 — calendar invite has been sent to Samir and Nina.

Looking forward to it.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
